_doc: Template for a subject added after the Astra round. Copy, rename, fill in the ids and run names.
previous_round.enabled=false switches the whole calibration off: summary.md then prints
'No previous round is available for these subjects ... (no previous round)' instead of empty tables,
and review-queue.md prints the same note in place of the disagreement table.
scopes: as long as the file does not exist, rq1_targets_deepseek.py fails (or skips with
--skip-missing-scopes) and rq1_summarize_deepseek.py replaces the three primary-target tables
with a note; it never reports K/N_API as zero.
audit_dir must live outside docs/design/cpv-expansion, docs/paper and eval (the tools refuse those).

review._doc: Leave system_prompt_file null to reuse the frozen v2.1 prompt verbatim. A prompt that names the new application must be supplied as a file together with its own prompt_version, so the provenance recorded in reviews.jsonl stays honest.
